channel.title: Merkle Street
channel.description: Merkle Street reports crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, layer 2s, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation, security incidents and protocol upgrades.

item.title: Binance sets Nov. 10 cutoff for mining pool services
item.description: Binance will close its mining pool and linked services on Nov. 10, ending mining credits at the cutoff and requiring users to move rigs and settle open positions.

item.title: Ledger Ties Confirmed Wallet Drains to CryptoBilis Reseller
item.description: Ledger says every confirmed drain in the Oct. 9 incident involved CryptoBilis-sold devices, but it has not disclosed customer losses or how the hardware was altered.

item.title: XRPL defends emergency fix for XRP overflow bug
item.description: XRPL developers say an emergency server patch stopped an order book overflow flaw that could create spendable XRP, bypassing the usual validator vote.

item.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC remittances for 82M devices
item.description: Samsung will add USDC transfers to Wallet for eligible US Galaxy users in late October, routing money to crypto wallets or bank accounts in over 60 countries.

item.title: ESMA opens inquiry into tokenised collateral for EU clearing
item.description: ESMA is asking market participants how tokenised collateral could work at EU clearing houses, testing whether existing safeguards can cover its risks.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for support, with $1 million each for six, as the crypto industry seeks allies after Senate action on its market-structure bill stalled.

item.title: ESMA opens review of tokenised collateral at EU clearing houses
item.description: ESMA opened a call for evidence on tokenised collateral at EU clearing houses, asking whether existing safeguards can handle its transfer, custody and use in defaults.

item.title: ESMA sets Jan. 8 deadline for EU crypto stablecoin holdings
item.description: ESMA told national regulators to stop EU crypto services for non-MiCA stablecoins, giving platforms up to three months to resolve customer holdings.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Crypto PAC Fairshake will back 32 House candidates, including six with $1 million in planned spending, as Senate gridlock leaves market rules unresolved.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for midterm support, including six slated for $1 million apiece, as the crypto market-structure bill remains stalled in the Senate.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House targets after crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake will back 32 House candidates, including six with $1 million each, as crypto firms seek allies after Senate lawmakers blocked market-structure rules.

item.title: Blast bridge pending: trace the transfer before acting
item.description: A Blast transfer can pause before the source transaction confirms; a withdrawal may still need its challenge period and final Ethereum step before funds arrive.

item.title: Fairshake names 32 House candidates for crypto spending
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House candidates for support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the stalled CLARITY Act leaves crypto rules unsettled.

item.title: Fairshake backs 32 House candidates as crypto bill stalls
item.description: Fairshake named 32 House incumbents for midterm support, including six slated for $1 million each, as the Senate’s crypto market-structure bill remains stalled.

item.title: Market Cap and FDV: What Changes as Token Supply Grows
item.description: Market cap uses circulating tokens, while FDV applies today’s price to a broader supply. Track unlocks and price separately to see what each figure can tell you.

item.title: SEC proposes guarded crypto self-custody for advisers and funds
item.description: The SEC proposed rules letting registered advisers and funds hold some crypto themselves under safeguards, creating a route when eligible outside custodians are unavailable.

item.title: Four Checks Before a Polygon PoS Withdrawal
item.description: A Polygon PoS withdrawal burns tokens on Polygon, waits for a validator checkpoint on Ethereum, then needs a separate claim; four checks help prevent avoidable errors.

item.title: What a USDT Energy Estimate Tells You
item.description: A USDT Energy estimate simulates a TRON token transfer to predict contract work, then helps separate Energy use from the TRX balance that may pay for it.

item.title: Armada II shareholders approve Evernorth’s XRP merger
item.description: Armada II shareholders approved its Evernorth merger, advancing a deal that expects to leave the combined company with 473 million XRP and a Nasdaq listing.

item.title: Set an Avalanche Swap Deadline That Gives You Time to Act
item.description: An Avalanche swap deadline gives a pending transaction a time limit. Set it to allow normal confirmation delays without leaving stale trades open too long.
